role: Tracks consecutive successes on repeated action types with diminishing relief returns (CANON §A.14).
detail: Exports SatisfactionHabituation class managing per-action-type success streaks via in-memory Map. computeRelief(actionType, outcome) returns 0 on failure (resets counter) or habituation curve value on success: 1st=0.05, 2nd=0.04, 3rd=0.03, 4th=0.02, 5-10th=0.01, 11th+=0.005. habituationCurve() applies diminishing returns so ~30 messages reach ~0.5 satisfaction, not spiking after 3. Also exports SatisfactionHabitationEffect interface (drive=Satisfaction, delta=number) and singleton getter getOrCreateSatisfactionHabituation(). reset() clears all state; getState() exposes current per-action-type counters. Type 1 computation — no blocking calls, pure in-memory.
gotchas: None visible — clean implementation matching CANON spec.
